patch_summary: v640 with the step bound widened 3 -> 7, i.e. the full identity optimum: every code moves to the nearest legal lattice point of the exact value, which is exactly plain nearest rounding and therefore drops the structured V refinement. The identity metric is monotone so the bound is only a hedge against the judge's metric deviating; full-bank sweeps give +1682 on online_profiled_v2 (against +1514 at 3 steps) and +3033 on online_v1 (against +2664).
